sentences.text:
Author: Juvvadi Sridevi
Bench: Juvvadi Sridevi
 Hon'Ble Smt. Justice Juvvadi Sridevi
 Criminal Petition No.9397 of 2023
Order:

Petitioners, who are accused Nos.1 to 5 in C.C.No.667 of 2017 on the file of Judicial First Class Magistrate at Kamareddy registered for the offences under Sections 498A, 406 r/w 34 of IPC and Section 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, are seeking to quash the proceedings against them.

entities.text: Judicial First Class Magistrate at Kamareddy
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. Heard learned counsel for petitioners and learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent-State and perused the record.
3.

Though this petition is filed for quashing the proceedings in the C.C., during the course of arguments, learned counsel for petitioners has sought for directions for early disposal of the C.C.
and also to the extent of dispensing with the appearance of the petitioners/accused Nos.1 to 5 before the trial Court.

4. In view of the submissions made by the learned counsel for the petitioners, the trial Court is directed to dispose of the C.C.No.667 of 2017 on the file of Judicial First Class Magistrate at Kamareddy, as expeditiously as possible, preferably within a period of three (03) months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.

entities.text: Judicial First Class Magistrate at Kamareddy
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
However, in view of the request made by the learned counsel for the petitioners, the appearance of the petitioners/ accused Nos.1 to 5 in C.C.No.667 of 2017 pending on the file of the learned Judicial First Class Magistrate at Kamareddy, is dispensed with,
except on the dates whenever their presence is required by the trial Court, and they shall be represented by their counsel on every date of hearing and in case of default, this order gets vacated automatically.
5. With the above directions, the Criminal Petition is disposed of.
Pending miscellaneous applications, if any, shall stand closed.

JUVVADI SRIDEVI, J Date: 06.12.2024 Ksk Miryalkar Srinivas Rao vs The State Of Telangana on 6 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/142497655/
